strings.The interface is standard MCP. ANIMA is: The interface is standard MCP. ANIMA is the initiator (the host), and servers come in two kinds — World Server and Engine Server. The brain always initiates and the server answers; the host opens one dedicated line per server (RemoteWorld / RemoteService in the code, MCP’s client layer). Each server describes itself with MCP’s three primitives: Tools (tools/call — actions or questions), Resources (resources/read anima://observation — a snapshot and structured state) and Prompts (prompts/get guidance — the guidance). A World Server has all three; an Engine Server has only tools, since an adviser does not perceive the world. Which servers to connect is assembled by ANIMA (the host) from its own configuration — config.worlds() / config.services() — so servers do not know one another, and a World Server never declares an Engine Server.
